text: Hello, I'm here with you. Let's take one small step together. A little focus, a little rest. You're doing well.
description: An original tiny animated kitten companion voice. Soft high light feminine register with a rounded plush little resonance. Sweet, cozy and gently playful, with smiling vowels, delicate bouncy phrase endings and clear tiny syllables. Intimate friendly conversation with a little cartoon character, not an adult narrator. No whispering, squealing, singing or exaggerated baby talk.
